entries.message: Actual Size (Command-0) also undoes a trackpad pinch. Thanks to Avelino (@avelino).
A link's menu now lists your other Spaces after Peek and Split View, and pages in Chromium no longer offer to open a link as another profile. Thanks to Gustavo Lima (@athousanddetails).
Pages in Chromium see federated sign-in again, so sites' fraud checks no longer count it missing as a sign of a tampered browser. Thanks to Josue A. Mendives (@JosueM1109).
